rubrics.title: Prepare a simple meal safely
rubrics.safety: Use a familiar safe recipe, suitable equipment and an appropriate trained observer. Stop when unsafe; no live hazards or required allergens. Written plans cannot prove cooking. Access adjustments are welcome.

scoring.criterion: Follows the chosen instructions and checks suitability with the observer before beginning.
scoring.guidance: An assessor must observe this action safely. Met means independently performed; partly met means incomplete; not met includes any unsafe action. Record solving help separately from access support.

scoring.criterion: Uses appropriate hand, surface and food hygiene without unsafe product mixing.

rubrics.title: Restore a harmless sample file
rubrics.safety: Use only a new harmless sample file in a sandbox or local practice folder. No deletion of real files, account secrets, unsafe downloads or remote sharing. A verbal plan cannot prove a restore.

scoring.criterion: Creates a fictional non-sensitive sample and a separate backup without exposing other files.

rubrics.title: Protect a demonstration account
rubrics.safety: Use an offline mock interface or authorised demonstration account only. Never show or store passwords, recovery codes, personal accounts or real credentials. No login required in this product.
